# Introduction
In this technical post-mortem, we will analyze the implementation of the second assignment, which involved creating a simple web application using Flask. The application was designed to allow users to submit their names and receive a personalized greeting. We will discuss the architecture of the application, the challenges faced during development, and the solutions implemented to overcome those challenges.
